title: XDrip+ is causing audio to pause
symptom: XDrip+ version c98a3c4-2021.10.17 is causing audio to pause when playing music/podcasts over Bluetooth. The pause happens when a connection is made with the G6 transmitter every 5 minutes, and is reproducible with all Bluetooth headphones and car Bluetooth. It also persisted after switching to the native Dexcom app.
cause: The thread identifies the Roku app installed on the phone, not XDrip+ or the Dexcom app, as the cause of the periodic Bluetooth audio pauses.
fix: Uninstall the Roku app completely. Removing media/file permission and clearing storage/cache did not help; only full uninstallation resolved the issue, as confirmed by several users.
settings_changed: disable BT A2DP Hardware offload → ON
evidence_quote: UPDATE: The issue seems to be coming for the Roku app. Deleting the Roku app resolves the issue.
